verification_scope_reason: Conditional registrations resolve serially once with captured agent/model/signal. Inspection remains distinct from executable lookup. A resolved set owns exact scope and registration identity, removes unloaded/replaced/restricted entries, never falls through a disabled shadow, and closes idempotently. Actual prepare/dispatch/complete consumers receive the same set; absent or closed admission cannot dispatch a conditional tool. Cancellation preserves the original reason ahead of condition failures. Existing scheduler, execution classification, request model selection and driver consumers remain covered.
observer_repairs: The initial Source observer incorrectly called a removed pipeline.execute shortcut; repaired to prepare/dispatch/complete. The expanded scoped observer initially minted under a context without tools injection; repaired to use an injected owner. Production implementation was unchanged during both observer repairs. Initial diagnostics remain preserved.
activation_boundary: Additive registry/pipeline contract. Agent step resolution, executor providers, prompt refresh, nested PTC binding and production composition are subsequent C5 work; this is not whole-tool parity or release acceptance. Production pin and accepted_upstream remain unchanged.
retained_assets: Commands, JSON observations, XML and logs retained. Shared fixed Source and toolchain remain owned by the migration until C9 qualification.
